mentions.name: Flora Carta
mentions.description: Flora Carta is a design tool for planning and keeping track of gardens, orchards, and landscape projects. It is in an early alpha release and includes a public browse page showcasing users' designs.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Flora Carta - https://floracarta.com

A tool to "Design and keep track of gardens, orchards, and landscape projects."

It's very alpha right now, so its quite ugly, but people are already using it.
